verdict.rationale: The only relevant evidence is the 'Review change requests with GitBook Agent' page title, which implies an automated AI review of edits before they merge and publish. The 'flags outdated content' claims are about content freshness, not style compliance. Nothing in the pack shows linting against a configurable style guide. missing for 10: evidence of style-guide rule configuration, a description of what the agent review actually checks, any blocking or pre-publish gating behavior, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
